category.quote: Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans: ₹ 1,00,000 (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) & ₹ 2,00,000 (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment)

age.quote: On the date of registration for the scheme, the minimum age of the applicant should be 18 years.

occupation.quote: The applicant should be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools.

gate_notes: Applicant must be engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades mentioned in the scheme
Applicant must be engaged in the unorganized sector on a self-employment basis and engaged in the concerned trade on the date of registration

Applicant should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of the Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra, in the past 5 years
Registration and benefits restricted to one member of the family; a person in government service and their family members shall not be eligible
